findingResolved: Case-insensitive root allowlist and case-sensitive history selection previously allowed OWNED-STATE.JSON.HISTORY to bypass content/ACL validation. Canonical case-sensitive directory admission now rejects it before mutation.
conclusions: Root ownership marker remains required. History directory is excluded from release-manifest discovery, then directory and each entry must pass the existing administrator/SYSTEM ACL assertion.

Each entry must be a regular non-reparse canonical SHA256.json leaf. Captured content is bounded to4MiB, read completely, checked for unexpected growth, hash-matched and parsed as object custody with object pendingTransaction if present. History bytes are never rewritten by admission.
Foreign recovery archives remain outside the installed runtime allowlist and are not silently adopted.
